APIRef_tm_analytics_network_stale-rules
mgmt/tm/analytics/network/stale-rules
/tm/analytics/network
Displays a network firewall stale rules report.
REST Endpoints
Collection URI
/mgmt/tm/analytics/network/stale-rules
Collection Methods
OPTIONS,
GET
Resource URI
/mgmt/tm/analytics/network/stale-rules/~resource
id
Resource Methods
OPTIONS,
GET
Properties
Name
Type
Default Value
Required
Access
Description
drilldown
string
optional
read/write
Specifies specific entities that are used as a filter.
firstRuleNumber
integer
optional
read/write
Specifies the first rule number being displayed. Rules are ordered by hit count in ascending order.
numberOfRules
integer
optional
read/write
Specifies the maximum number of firewall rules displayed in the output result set. The default value is 10.
range
string
optional
read/write
Specifies the time/date range of the analytics information that you want to display. The displayed results reflect the time range specified. The default value is the last hour (now–now-1h).
type
string
enforced
required
read/write
Specifies the type of rules being displayed: either enforced or staged.
